First steps in faith

You’re already welcome here—brand-new faith, a fresh start, or honest curiosity. Nothing on this page rushes you or scores your pace.

Whether you are brand-new or starting again, this page gathers the same KJV Battle Plans the site already uses—one verse a day, plain words, a small step, a short prayer. Progress stays on your device; use Listen on any day if you want it read aloud.

If you are wondering how to come to Christ

The Road to Salvation is five quiet days in the KJV—our need, God's love, the cross, faith, and new life. No test at the end. Come as you are. When you only want the Lord Jesus's own words, Only His Voice (red letters only) is five quiet days of listening.

Open the gospel path Print all five days

Start with fourteen honest days

New Believer — First Steps walks salvation, grace, prayer, the Word, and gathering with God's people—no rush, no performance story.

When you are ready for the next lane

  • Who God says you are — calm hub plus seven days in Christ.
  • John sampler — Christ on every page in one Gospel.
  • Walk the Word — hear and do, not hear only.
  • Holy Spirit — Comforter, truth, fruit, walking in the Spirit.
  • Stand firm — temptation, escape, watch and pray.
  • Great Commission — salt, light, beautiful feet—gentle boldness.
  • Stewardship — contentment and giving; pairs with Work & Daily Labor.
  • Daily quiet time — verse, Calm, one plan day, My Study, and prayer on one screen.
  • Psalms hub — comfort, praise, and family Psalms plans.
